Module GoannaWatch
Package GoannaWatch.observations.model

Class ObservationService

java.lang.Object
GoannaWatch.observations.model.ObservationService
public class ObservationService extends Object
Encapsulation of business logic and rules about editing, commenting etc. Controllers call service layer rather than DAOs
